summary: The diff adds a Capacitor-based Android wrapper project under frontend/android and adds Android/Capacitor-related utilities. However, the Internet Identity Android login compatibility is only partially addressed (shim exists but no evidence it is actually invoked to drive the login flow), and the Android build documentation appears truncated/incomplete with no confirmed debug/release build commands or APK output locations. The backend and various frontend features were modified beyond the packaging/auth/documentation scope.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure Internet Identity authentication works from the Android app context by handling login flow in a way compatible with Android WebView/app wrapper (e.g., opening the identity provider in an external browser/custom tab and returning to the app), without changing the immutable Internet Identity hook files.
missing_requirements.reason: A WebView shim is added and initialized, and Android deep-link intent filters are added, but there is no evidence in the diff that the actual Internet Identity `login()` flow is routed through the shim (e.g., calling `openIILoginInBrowser()` with the II URL or otherwise preventing the blocked popup). LoginButton still calls `await login()` directly.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add concise build documentation to the repo describing prerequisites and step-by-step instructions to produce debug and release APK artifacts for the app.
missing_requirements.reason: A build guide file is added, but its content is truncated in the diff summary right after the 'Install Frontend Dependencies' heading, and the release-signing README is also truncated. There is no confirmed evidence that the documentation includes exact debug/release build commands and the APK output locations as required by the acceptance criteria.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend authorization system and user profile/marks access-control logic added/modified in backend/main.mo.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on Android APK packaging, Android-compatible Internet Identity login flow, and build documentation. It explicitly constrains the backend to remain a single Motoko actor but does not request new authorization/profile features or significant backend logic changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Multiple unrelated frontend feature/UI changes (sessions/students/marks/results screens, styling, splash screen, labels) beyond Android packaging/auth/documentation.
hallucinated_features.reason: These changes are not part of REQ-1/REQ-2/REQ-3 and are outside the requested scope (package app as APK, ensure II auth works in Android context, add build docs).
